plugins.name: turtini
plugins.description: Wires the Turtini MCP server into Claude Code so your IDE agent can read and write your Turtini org's data — contacts, accounts, opportunities, articles, events — while it codes. Includes a /turtini skill for guided setup, API key minting, and connection verification.

skills.name: turtini
skills.description: Wire the Turtini MCP server into Claude Code, mint an API key, verify the connection, and surface the tools the IDE agent gets. Use when the user mentions "Turtini", asks how to "set up Turtini MCP", wants to give their Claude Code agent access to a CRM / ops backend, or needs help getting / rotating their TURTINI_API_KEY. Also use when the user is debugging a failing Turtini MCP connection.
headings: `/turtini` — Connect Claude Code to your Turtini workspace
Routing — figure out what the user wants
Step 1 — mint a Turtini API key
Step 3 — restart Claude Code, then verify
Manual `claude mcp add` path (only if the plugin isn't installed)
